answer: The admission burn is multiplied by 6 for each member already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival forfeits the most. The crystal multiplier is published, charged in pigment, and canyon lists each payment. A burst of registrations therefore prices itself out, as the marginal alias burns more than the first by design. A farm of 2537 identities would post 703 proofs and burn roughly 65 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
